hero.subtitle: Software engineer and PhD in mechanics. I build applications that put data to work — from data modelling to production — and stay close to the people who use them every day.

about.p1: I’ve worked on projects in France, the United Kingdom and Algeria. Different teams, cultures and ways of working taught me to read the context before proposing anything, and to adapt rather than apply a ready-made recipe.
about.p2: To me, good software is measured by the time it saves the people who use it, not by how sophisticated it is under the hood.
about.p3: That’s what drives my technical choices: I’d rather ship the solution a team can keep alive after I’m gone than the one that looks most impressive today.

research.meta_desc: Peer-reviewed scientific publications — mechanics, wave propagation and numerical modelling applied to underground structures.
research.lead: Before software engineering, there was research.
research.intro_1: My doctorate tackled a demanding engineering problem: predicting how underground structures — tunnels, cavities — respond to mechanical and seismic waves. A concrete stake for the safety and design of infrastructure.
research.intro_2: This work combines continuum mechanics, wave propagation, mathematical modelling and numerical methods. It taught me to break a complex problem down, model it rigorously, solve it, then confront my results with measurement — reflexes I now apply, every day, in software engineering.
research.impact_lead: Research is not a parenthesis in my path: it is the foundation of the way I work.
research.impact_1_d: Break down an ill-posed problem, frame it, then solve it methodically.
research.impact_2_d: Turn a real problem into a workable model without betraying its physics.
research.impact_3_d: Reason in cost, accuracy and convergence before writing a single line.
research.impact_4_d: Explicit assumptions, reproducible results, verifiable conclusions.
research.impact_5_d: Work with large volumes and extract the useful signal from them.
research.impact_6_d: Systematically confront the model with measurement — and doubt both.
research.impact_7_d: Make a complex idea clear for a non-specialist audience.
research.impact_8_d: Carry demanding, self-directed work over several years, all the way through.
